name: eq0hnw-canary-answer-actors
goal: The needs-you release canary passes each surface only on what that app really writes to the Tracker: Hub web 'Daniel via Hub', Mac app 'daniel', iPhone 'Daniel'

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Failing: judgeAnswer requires answered_by 'daniel' for every surface. Real writes (same on release A d9f4d8e430, candidate 64fc542631 and head): Hub web homeTrackerChat sends by 'Daniel via Hub'; iPhone PhoneReplicaWriteService sends by 'Daniel'; Mac app /items/:id/inbox sends none, so 'daniel'. A working release would be failed and its item blocked. Expected: each surface passes only on what its own app writes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Gap: test/support/needsYouCanaryWorld.ts applied every tap through the item rules with no by, so all three surfaces read 'daniel', and test 1 asserted that. The r871 rehearsal used synthetic answers; the fixture web proof checked the sent option, not answered_by. Reusable change: test/support/needsYouCanaryClients.ts drives deliverHomeChat, MacTrackerInboxService and PhoneReplicaWriteService into a real in-memory Tracker.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record red at dceb03193f (test-only commit): bunx vitest run test/needs-you-canary.test.ts test/needs-you-canary-answer-paths.test.ts, 7 failed / 10 passed. All taps accepted by the real Tracker; failures are canary verdicts: real Hub web and iPhone answers judged failed, and web/iPhone asks answered through the Mac app judged passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
